For Missouri, the best all-around native milkweeds are:

Common milkweed (Asclepias syriaca), tough, very attractive to monarchs, best for larger/less formal spaces (spreads).

Swamp milkweed (Asclepias incarnata), great monarch plant for rain gardens and average-to-moist soils; less aggressive.

Butterfly weed (Asclepias tuberosa), best for dry, sunny sites and tidy gardens; orange flowers.

Whorled milkweed (Asclepias verticillata), good for dry/poor soils; fine-textured, less showy but useful.

We have all of them here: https://lasclay.com/en-us/collections/garden
